description:
Verify your email and receive your API key.

After calling mcp_register, check your email for the 6-digit code
and pass it here. On success, returns your production and test
API keys. You must subscribe at ohmyfin.ai/subscription to
activate paid tools.

Args:
    email: The email you registered with.
    code: The 6-digit verification code from your email.

Examples:
  mcp_verify("agent@example.com", "123456")
name: mcp_verify
